## Partner v0.3.3

This release rebuilds session compaction and memory recall, adds speech bubbles to the desktop pet, refines file operations and per-action approval levels, and improves voice responses.

- **Compaction and memory recall:** Session compaction now folds older complete turns into an atomic summary checkpoint while keeping replayable history, and context budgeting fits turns newest-first within the 60% post-compaction target. Memory recall uses anchor-based scoring with source-time recency, pronoun-aware candidate queries, and deduplication across working and promoted records.
- **Session history and tool budgets:** Added the `session_history` tool so the main agent can search and paginate workspace history (including compacted turns). Intact-content tool results skip capping, and capped results return cursor-preserving retry guidance.
- **File operations and approvals:** Added governed native file creation and transactional exact-match editing with structured receipts. Per-action approval levels were adjusted: commands now require approval only under "Approve everything", while file writes and edits require approval under both "Approve everything" and "Approve risky actions".
- **Desktop pet:** Added speech bubbles for finalized assistant replies, with automatic corner placement inside the monitor work area.
- **Services, schedules, and sub-agents:** Memory Services recall skips tool-result-only messages and reserves output budget per OpenAI/Anthropic protocol without trimming client history. Scheduled `web_fetch` tasks track per-target 5xx/2xx status anomalies using hashed targets. Queued sub-agent jobs now report an empty session before their log file exists, and spoken voice responses and agent routing were refined.

## Notes

- Live2D Core and models remain user-supplied. See the [desktop control](https://github.com/Jaspersol/partner/blob/v0.3.3/doc/desktop-control.en.md), [memory](https://github.com/Jaspersol/partner/blob/v0.3.3/doc/memory.en.md), [pet](https://github.com/Jaspersol/partner/blob/v0.3.3/doc/pet.en.md) and [voice](https://github.com/Jaspersol/partner/blob/v0.3.3/doc/voice.en.md) documentation.
